materials.title: Data Structures & Algorithms Lecture Notes

materials.title: Database Management Systems - Normalization Guide

materials.description: Step-by-step breakdown of 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, and BCNF relational database design with real-world decomposition examples.

materials.title: Operating Systems - Process Scheduling & Memory Management
materials.subject: Computer Science
materials.description: Covers CPU scheduling algorithms (FCFS, SJF, Round Robin), deadlocks, semaphores, and virtual memory page replacement.

materials.title: Computer Networks - TCP/IP Protocol Suite & Routing
materials.subject: Information Technology
materials.description: In-depth reference on OSI vs TCP/IP models, subnetting, CIDR, distance vector routing, and socket programming fundamentals.

assignments.title: Implement Red-Black Tree in C++
assignments.subject: Computer Science
assignments.description: Write a complete C++ program to implement Red-Black Tree insertion, deletion, and search operations with self-balancing rotation visualization.

assignments.title: E-Commerce Database Schema Design & SQL Queries
assignments.subject: Information Technology

assignments.title: Virtual Memory Page Replacement Simulation
assignments.subject: Computer Science
assignments.description: Simulate FIFO, LRU, and Optimal page replacement algorithms in Python or Java. Compare page fault frequencies for reference strings.
